events.content:
Implemented the product catalog page with a regular HTML form and an inline Server Action. The action calls `revalidateTag('products', 'max')`, so catalog reads can serve cached data while Next refreshes it in the background.

`getAllProducts` is cached with the same `"products"` tag in [lib/db.js](/workspace/lib/db.js). The page also includes product search and inventory summaries, with styling in [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css).

`npx tsc --noEmit` passes. I did not run tests. The repository’s catalog query is still simulated data; there is no ERP/PIM connector here, so the refreshed query will need to read from the integrated data source.
